name: taji
description: LudoEnergía — juego de cartas TAJI (client + server) y sitio de acceso abierto

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix site install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,site -c green,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix site run dev"
scripts.dev:game: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix site run build
